title: SimpleWarps
body:
Features

Set warps anywhere in the world (/setwarp <name>).

Teleport to warps instantly or with a delay (/warp <name>).

Delete warps (/delwarp <name>).

List all available warps (/warps).

Fully configurable messages with color codes.

Optional teleport particles and sounds.

Supports cross-world teleportation.

Warp data saved in warps.yml for persistence.

Permissions
Permission	Description	Default
simplewarps.setwarp	Allows setting warps	OP
simplewarps.delwarp	Allows deleting warps	OP
simplewarps.use	Allows using warps	TRUE
simplewarps.list	Allows listing all warps	TRUE
Commands
Command	Usage	Permission	Description
/setwarp	/setwarp <name>	simplewarps.setwarp	Create a warp at your location
/warp	/warp <name>	simplewarps.use	Teleport to a warp
/delwarp	/delwarp <name>	simplewarps.delwarp	Delete a warp
/warps	/warps	simplewarps.list	List all warps
YAML Files

config.yml → plugin settings and messages.

warps.yml → stores all warp data (world, coordinates, yaw/pitch)
